words.gloss_range: opening conjunction that links this clause into the continuing declaration chain
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) makes the ayah enter already connected. It carries 53:48 into the continuing declaration sequence rather than letting provision stand as an isolated economic sentence, while the fused opening with the following particle tightens the clause before the agent and paired verbs arrive.

topics.headline: serial declaration link
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the provision claim is ranked inside the same divine-act catalogue as the surrounding declarations, not detached from them.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence identifies a repeated wa-annahu divine predication formula with an anchor at 53:43, and the opening particle is syntactically forced as part of the clause.

topics.headline: compressed opening beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the connector and emphatic frame arrive as one compressed opening before the verbs are delayed.
topics.reason: The surface joins the conjunction directly to the emphatic particle, and the following independent pronoun means the paired verbs do not arrive until after the agent has been foregrounded.

words.gloss_range: emphatic subordinating particle with attached 3ms pronoun, carrying the same referent into a confirmed clause
words.prose: {{ar:أَنَّهُۥ}} ({{tr:annahu}}) compresses emphatic subordination and the divine pronoun into one word. The suffix is already the governed subject of the particle, so the later {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) does extra separating and restrictive work; the accepted {{ar:وَإِنَّهُ}} ({{tr:wa-innahu}}) variant shows that the claim can be heard as direct emphasis, but the canonical surface keeps it embedded in the surrounding chain.

topics.headline: embedded confirmed claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the provision statement is a confirmed member of the larger chain, while the variant contrast marks the same claim as capable of direct assertion without changing the local verb pair.
topics.reason: The canonical particle opens the clause as embedded content, while the cited variant is useful as contrast but does not govern the canonical parse.

topics.headline: suffix prepares separation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that reference is already supplied before the independent pronoun, so the next pronoun is not redundant but prepares exclusive agency.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the suffix the governed pronoun of the particle and treats the following pronoun as co-referring separation before the predicate.

words.gloss_range: independent 3ms pronoun functioning locally as a separating and restricting pronoun
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) is not needed merely to identify the referent, because that has already been done by the suffix in {{ar:أَنَّهُۥ}} ({{tr:annahu}}). Its payoff is separation and qasr: the agent is isolated before the two verbs, and the same pattern resonates with the divine-act sequence in 53:43-49, including the paired acts at 53:43 and 53:44.

topics.headline: exclusive agent marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pronoun pauses the clause to isolate the actor before enrichment and endowment are named.
topics.reason: The suffix already supplies reference, so the independent pronoun is licensed as separation and exclusive attribution before the coordinated predicates.

topics.headline: serial exclusive pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees wealth provision placed into the same exclusive-agent pattern as nearby paired divine acts in 53:43-49.
topics.reason: The row gives concrete same-surah references for the repeated pronoun pattern, and local syntax supports the same separating function here.

words.gloss_range: caused wealth, sufficiency, or freedom from need, with the recipient left unexpressed
words.root_gloss_range: self-sufficiency, wealth, availing, and other branch meanings; locally the Form IV predicate selects caused sufficiency/enrichment, not the song branch
words.prose: {{ar:أَغْنَىٰ}} ({{tr:aghnā}}) is a perfect Form IV verb, so the point is not merely that someone is rich but that the exclusive agent causes wealth or sufficiency to occur. Its object is unexpressed, letting the act stay broad while the root {{ar:غ ن ي}} ({{tr:gh-n-y}}) keeps divine self-sufficiency, freedom from need, and material wealth in contact; in this surah, that positive divine capacity answers the earlier negated availing language at 53:26 and 53:28, while the self-sufficiency claim in 96:7 shows the gift can be distorted into imagined autonomy. The shared Form IV shape and long ending also make it the first half of the pair completed by {{ar:أَقْنَىٰ}} ({{tr:aqnā}}), so provision begins as caused sufficiency and moves toward retention or contentment.

topics.headline: caused sufficiency without named recipient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a completed divine act of causing sufficiency, with the recipient left open rather than narrowed to one beneficiary.
topics.reason: The local verb is perfect Form IV with a syntactically controlled 3ms subject and an absolute no-object frame.

topics.headline: wealth as freedom from need
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps material enrichment and freedom from need together instead of reducing the verb to either money alone or inward sufficiency alone.
topics.reason: V4 accepts the wealth, need-reduction, and availing branches, and local pairing with the next verb keeps the economic field active.

topics.headline: first half of provision pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first verb as the generation side of a two-part provision movement that the next verb will secure.
topics.reason: The following verb is conjoined as the second predicate, and the two forms share pattern and cadence while keeping distinct roots.

topics.headline: availing and autonomy reversed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same root field move from what lesser claims cannot make avail in 53:26 and 53:28 to what God positively causes in 53:48, with 96:7 showing the opposite danger of treating sufficiency as self-generated.
topics.reason: The contextual profile shows the form family often appears in negated or scoped environments, while the CRITICAL rows supply concrete same-surah contrasts.

topics.headline: from re-creation to provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the catalogue shift from obligation and origination into completed provision without breaking the chain.
topics.reason: The verb is the first predicate after the clause frame and starts the economic provision pair.

topics.headline: song branch not local
topics.blocking_evidence: V4 lists a song and vocal-modulation branch for {{ar:غ ن ي}} ({{tr:gh-n-y}}), but formal branch presence is not local activation, and this word is a Form IV provision predicate coordinated with another economic verb.
topics.reason: The local syntax and paired economic predicate block turning the word into a vocal or song image.

words.gloss_range: medial conjunction binding the second perfect verb to the first while leaving precise timing open

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first Form IV verb in the pair
second Form IV verb in the pair

words.prose: The medial {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the hinge of the ayah's provision pair. It binds {{ar:أَقْنَىٰ}} ({{tr:aqnā}}) to {{ar:أَغْنَىٰ}} ({{tr:aghnā}}) under the same restricted agent, lets addition and ordered progression both remain possible, and gives the two long-matched verbs a brief reset that keeps them distinct while still heard as one compound predicate.

topics.headline: second verb bound to first
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second verb is not a new sentence but a coordinated predicate under the same exclusive agent.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence directly marks the second verb as conjoined with the first.

topics.headline: timing left open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel enrichment and endowment as both joined aspects and a possible movement from sufficiency toward retained possession.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates without forcing a single temporal reading.

topics.headline: brief cadence reset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a tiny break that separates the matched verbs without loosening their pair structure.
topics.reason: The short conjunction appears between two matched perfective verbs and also mirrors the opening connector at the clause level.

words.gloss_range: caused possession, retained endowment, or contentment, with no explicit recipient or object
words.root_gloss_range: retained possession, kept property, and contentment are locally relevant; other root branches remain guardrail background only
words.prose: {{ar:أَقْنَىٰ}} ({{tr:aqnā}}) closes the ayah as the rare second Form IV verb of the pair. Its causative shape keeps endowment under the same restricted agent, its missing object leaves the beneficiary open, and the root {{ar:ق ن ي}} ({{tr:q-n-y}}) presses beyond generic giving toward retained possession and even settled contentment. Because the root is a Quranic hapax in the supplied evidence, the immediate pairing with {{ar:أَغْنَىٰ}} ({{tr:aghnā}}) does heavy work: sufficiency is not only generated, it is held, secured, or inwardly settled. The matched ending and near sound-pairing make that final word feel like the landing point of one compound provision act before the next declaration moves to cosmic lordship in 53:49.

topics.headline: caused endowment under same agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second verb also names a caused act by the same exclusive agent while leaving the recipient unspecified.
topics.reason: The local frame marks no explicit object and a syntactically controlled 3ms subject; the intransitive label is retained as a valency caution, not as cancellation of Form IV causative force.

topics.headline: retained possession and settled contentment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps both durable possession and inward contentment in view, so the second verb is not flattened into ordinary giving.
topics.reason: V4 supports retained possession and contentment branches, and the local pair with the sufficiency verb makes both reader-facing rather than accidental.

topics.headline: hapax controlled by its pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that this rare word must be read from its immediate neighbors rather than stabilized by other Quranic contexts.
topics.reason: The contextual profile marks the exact root-form as a single occurrence, with the only collocational control coming from the paired verb.

topics.headline: paired sound closes provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final verb as both matched with the first and semantically distinct, closing on retention rather than repeating enrichment.
topics.reason: The two verbs share Form IV shape, nasal and long-final cadence, and close guttural onsets while their roots diverge.

topics.headline: provision before cosmic lordship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the catalogue moving from re-creation into lived provision here, then outward toward cosmic lordship in 53:49.
topics.reason: The final word closes the provision ayah and prepares the next declaration while remaining under the same serial frame.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَغْنَىٰ at word 3 coordinated with أَقْنَىٰ at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first causative removes need by making something sufficient or availing; the second converts sufficiency into a possession kept beyond immediate use. The verbs mark a two-stage economy rather than tautological enrichment.

activation_trace.role: Sufficing, availing, or standing in supplies the immediate need-ending phase.
Property retained after sufficiency supplies the durable-reserve phase.

changed_reading.before: He made rich and gave property.
changed_reading.after: He makes provision actually suffice, then makes what exceeds immediate need remain as a durable reserve.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated causatives can name two different releases from need: independence and satisfaction.
baseline_models.mechanism: External sufficiency and internal satisfaction are separable gifts. The first reduces dependence; the second settles desire with what has been given, so abundance need not mean accumulation.

activation_trace.role: Wealth and self-sufficiency locate the first gift in freedom from need.
Being made satisfied and settling with a gift turns the second verb inward as contentment.

changed_reading.before: He increases someone's wealth and holdings.
changed_reading.after: He grants independence from need and brings wanting to rest in contentment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَغْنَىٰ supplies enough; أَقْنَىٰ can supply accord or intermixture.
baseline_models.mechanism: Enough is not only a quantity. The second causative can make the provision compatible with, assimilable to, or fitting for its recipient, producing tailored sufficiency.

activation_trace.role: Effective sufficing supplies the quantity or function that answers need.
Intermixing and compatibility make what suffices fit the being or system receiving it.

changed_reading.after: He makes enough and makes that enough fit, mix with, or accord with its recipient.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both focus roots have spatial branches: settled dwelling and a shade that preserves dew.
baseline_models.mechanism: The pair can spatialize sufficiency as habitat: a place becomes inhabitable, then its sheltered microclimate retains what continued life needs.

activation_trace.role: Long residence and settled dwelling turn sufficiency into habitability.
A sun-sheltered place that keeps dew supplies environmental retention.

changed_reading.after: He makes a place livable and makes its shelter retain what living there requires.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The marriage-protection branch of غ ن ي can couple with the fitting/intermixing branch of ق ن ي.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sufficiency can be relational rather than proprietary: joining protects against lack, while compatibility lets the joined parties function together.

activation_trace.role: Marriage as sufficiency or protection supplies a relational form of freedom from need.
Compatibility and intermixture make the protected pair operative rather than merely adjacent.

changed_reading.after: He makes partners a protection or sufficiency for one another and fits them together.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَغْنَىٰ can make an act avail, while أَقْنَىٰ can requite it with its due return.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two causatives can form an economy of answerability: an act is made effective and then met with the return properly corresponding to it.

activation_trace.role: Availing supplies the efficacy of the act or provision.
Due recompense supplies a corresponding return rather than another possession.

changed_reading.after: He makes an act avail and answers it with its due requital.

context_deltas.mechanism: Intercession joined to another and conjecture opposed to truth are both explicitly unable to avail anything. Their failures turn the positive causative at 53:48 into a claim about effective sufficing agency: God makes something actually answer a need or stand in for another, then can stabilize the result as a possession.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch names the effective availing that the context repeatedly denies to substitutes.
Retained property gives the successfully availing provision a durable outcome.
Negated sufficing or standing-in shows that intercession has no independent efficacy.
An advocate joining another supplies the would-be substitute whose availing is denied.

strongest_changes: Repeated negated uses of غ ن ي make 53:48 a claim about the exclusive capacity to make anything truly avail, not wealth alone.
The cutoff gift and the effort-to-full-recompense sequence turn the focus pair into competing processes: enough becoming durable reserve, or effective action becoming due return.
The creation sequence activates relational fitting, while the following destruction makes every retained possession contingent rather than self-securing.
summary.what_was_special: The coordinated causatives form a hinge: غ ن ي supplies sufficiency, independence, voice, dwelling, or marital protection, while the single-occurrence ق ن ي fans into retention, contentment, fitting, requital, shade, cluster, and channel. Context selectively activates several of these without forcing them into one final sense.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not settle whether أَقْنَىٰ privileges stored possession, contentment, compatibility, or recompense.
The habitat, acoustic, harvest, and gendered readings are branch-grounded but form-distant and must remain qualified exploratory activations.
The arrows from surrounding sequences into 53:48 are abductive; the repeated clauses may enumerate powers without making each neighboring item causally interpret the next.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Sufficiency followed by retained possession.** غ ن ي B001 supplies self-sufficiency and wealth; ق ن ي B002 supplies stored property kept as one's own. The paired causatives distinguish having enough from retaining surplus or asset. I infer that provision and durable possession are separate gifts; the ayah reads as a two-stage economy.
2. **Sufficing and contenting.** غ ن ي B002 supplies making something suffice; ق ن ي B008 supplies contentment with what is given. I infer that external provision becomes inward settlement through contentment; the ayah preserves a psychological economy alongside material acquisition.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 53:51's “left no remainder” activates a stark reversal of ق ن ي B002 retained possession. The one who enables durable holdings also controls whether a community retains any surviving reserve.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Sufficiency and durable possession are separate grants.** `غ ن ي B001` supplies self-sufficiency and wealth, while `ق ن ي B002` supplies retained possession and stored property. The paired causatives distinguish obtaining enough from keeping an asset; 53:50-53 then supplies destruction, no remainder, and casting down. The packet supplies provision, retention, and later revocation of persistence; I infer the arrow granted means plus granted retention -> durable wealth, with neither stage autonomous. The fixed ayah reads as a two-stage economy of provision and holding.

2. **External means and inward enoughness can coexist as distinct readings.** `غ ن ي B001` again supplies wealth, but `ق ن ي B008` supplies contentment and being satisfied. The earlier affective pair and the later lordship statement keep inner state and outer condition under one subject. The packet supplies wealth, contentment, and one causative agent; I infer the arrow provision plus settled desire -> experienced sufficiency. This reading does not merge possession with contentment; it preserves both accepted `ق ن ي` mechanisms.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - Later 53:49-53 separated possession from permanence: lordship is followed by ruin, no residue, transgressive collectives, and downward overthrow.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği bir yerde oturmak ve uzun süre kalmaktır; geçmişte orada yaşamış olma ile ev ve yer adları buna bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bir yerde uzun kalma ve geçmişte orada yaşama anlamları belirli bağıntılı yapılarda görünür; yalın ad biçimleri ise kalma eylemini veya oturulan yeri gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yerde oturmak, orada uzun süre kalmak ve yaşamak anlamıdır. Geçmişte orada bulunmuş olma anlatımı ile bir topluluğun oturduğu evleri, kalma eylemini veya kalınan yeri bildiren adlar bu çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Kişi veya topluluk belirli bir yerde oturur ve orada uzun süre kalır.

Bir topluluğun oturduğu evler ile kalma eylemi veya kalınan yer bu çekirdekten adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bir yerde oturma ve uzun süre kalma çekirdeğinde birleşir; geçmişte orada yaşama anlatımını, topluluğun evlerini ve hem eylemi hem yeri gösterebilen adları da bu alana bağlar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, eşi veya güzelliği sayesinde takı ve süslenmeye ihtiyaç duymadığı düşünülen kadın açıklamasını güçlü biçimde destekler; ancak bütün tanımlar bu sınırı korumaz. Bazı kullanımlar genç evli kadın, güzel genç kadın, evli olsun olmasın güzel kadın, hatta genel olarak kadın düzeyine kadar genişler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Süsten bağımsız sayılma ana açıklamadır, fakat sözcük her kaynakta aynı koşulları taşımaz; gençlik, güzellik, evlilik ve genel kadın kullanımları ayrı sınır çeşitleridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın kadın nitelemesine bağlıdır; eşi, güzelliği, gençliği veya evliliği anlatan sınır çeşitleri korunur ve başka dallardaki evlenme olayına dönüştürülmez.

concept_map.definition: Eşi sayesinde takıya gerek duymadığı veya güzelliği nedeniyle süslenmeye ihtiyaç duymadığı düşünülen kadını anlatan bir nitelemedir. Kullanım sınırı bazı kaynaklarda genç evli kadın, güzel genç kadın, evli olsun olmasın güzel kadın, hatta genel olarak kadın olacak kadar genişler.

facets.statement: Kadın, eşi veya kendi güzelliği sayesinde takı ve süslenmeye ihtiyaç duymayan biri olarak nitelenir.
Nitelemenin sınırı gençlik, güzellik veya evlilik koşullarından yalnızca birine dayanabilir.
En geniş kaynak kullanımında niteleme belirli bir koşul aranmadan genel olarak kadına uygulanabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kadın nitelemesinde birleşir, fakat sınırı farklı kurar: eşi veya güzelliği nedeniyle süse ihtiyaç duymama ana açıklamadır; gençlik, güzellik, evlilik ve koşulsuz kadın kullanımları daha geniş çeşitlerdir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi güneş ışığı almayan, özellikle kışın gölgede kalan bir yeri doğrudan tanımlar ve böyle bir yerin nemi koruyabileceğini ekler. Geçici çerçeve mekânı ve güneşten korunma koşulunu doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek yalnız gölgenin kendisi değil, güneşin ulaşmadığı kalıcı gölgeli yerdir; nemi tutması buna bağlı bir sonuçtur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak yer adını güneş almayan mekânla sınırlar; gölge, barınak veya nemin her türünü kapsamaz.

concept_map.definition: Güneşin ulaşmadığı ve bu yüzden gölgenin kalıcı olduğu yerdir; bazı kullanımlarda özellikle kışın güneş görmemesi belirtilir. Böyle bir yerin çiği ve nemi koruması ona bağlı bir sonuçtur.

facets.statement: Yer doğrudan güneş ışığı almaz ve sürekli gölgede kalır.
Bazı söyleyişler güneş almama koşulunu özellikle kış mevsimiyle sınırlar.
Güneşten korunan bu yer çiği ve nemi tutabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak anlatımı güneş almayan gölgeli yerde birleşir; kış sınırı ve nemi koruma özelliği bu mekânın özel nitelikleri olarak verilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Güneş ışığının ulaşmadığı ve gölgenin mekâna sürekli bağlı olduğu yer için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Mekânı, güneş almama koşulunu ve kalıcı gölge niteliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Güneşten korunma koşulunun özellikle kış mevsimi için belirtildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Güneş almayan mekânı ve kış mevsimi sınırlamasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Yılın başka zamanlarında güneş görmeyen yerleri dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gölgenin yerdeki nemi ve çiği korumasının öne çıktığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gölgeli yerin nemi ve çiği koruma sonucunu açıkça belirtir.
error_profile.loses: Güneş almayan fakat nem tutması özellikle belirtilmeyen yerleri dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi burnun kemiksi bölümü ile yumuşak ucu arasında bulunan çıkıntı veya kavisi, burun deliklerindeki darlık ayrıntısını ve yırtıcı kuş gagasındaki kancalı benzerini açıkça verir. Geçici çerçeve bu ortak biçim özelliğini doğru tanımlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam genel yükseklik veya her türlü eğrilik değil, burun sırtındaki belirgin kavisli çıkıntı ve kuş gagasındaki kancalı karşılığıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım burundaki biçimi temel alır, kuş gagası ve niteleme kalıplarını ayrı kapsamlar olarak belirtir.

concept_map.definition: Burnun üst ya da orta bölümünde, kemiksi bölüm ile yumuşak uç arasında belirgin ama çirkin sayılmayan bir kavis veya çıkıntı bulunmasıdır; burun delikleri de dar olabilir. Yırtıcı kuşların gagasındaki kancalı kıvrım aynı biçim alanında anlatılır.

facets.statement: Burun sırtında kemiksi bölüm ile yumuşak uç arasında belirgin bir kavis veya çıkıntı bulunur.
Bu burun biçimine öne çıkma ve burun deliklerinin dar olması eşlik edebilir; görünüş çirkin sayılmaz.
Yırtıcı kuşların gagasındaki kancalı kıvrım aynı biçim özelliğinin hayvanlara uzanan kullanımıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar burun sırtındaki kavisli çıkıntıda birleşir; dar burun delikleri ve yırtıcı kuş gagasındaki kanca biçimi ayrıntıyı genişletir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi uzun çubuk veya mızrak anlamını, yer altında açılan su yolunu, omurları düzenleyen sırt hattını ve boyu aynı adlandırma alanında toplar. Bunlar tek bir somut nesne değildir; uzun, doğrusal, boğumlu ya da borumsu yapı benzerliğiyle bağlanan çıplak ve kalıplaşmış kullanımlardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Mızrak ve çubuk temel nesne alanıdır; su yolu, omurga hattı ve boy anlamları yalnız kendi belirtilmiş kalıplarında geçerlidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak addaki mızrak ve çubuğu, su yolu, sırt ve boy bildiren kalıplardan açıkça ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Çıplak kullanımda dikilip kaldırılabilen uzun bir çubuk, sopa veya boğumlu kamış yapısındaki mızraktır. Belirli kalıplarda yer altından geçen su yolu, omurları bir sırada tutan sırt çizgisi ya da insanın boyu aynı uzun ve doğrusal yapı benzerliğiyle adlandırılır.

facets.statement: Uzun, düz ve kimi zaman kamış gibi boğumlu bir mızrak, çubuk veya sopa gösterilir.
Yer altında kazılan ve suyu taşıyan borumsu geçit yalnız suyla kurulan yapıda bu adla anılır.
Omurları doğrusal biçimde sıralayan sırt hattı yalnız sırtla kurulan yapıda gösterilir.
Bazı kullanımlarda aynı uzunluk ve diklik benzerliği insanın boyuna aktarılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu anlatım uzun mızrak veya çubuk çekirdeğini, yer altı su yolu ve omurga hattı kalıplarını ve boy kullanımını doğrusal yapı benzerliği çevresinde birleştirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi birini hoşnut etmeyi, verilen payla yetinip gönlünün yatışmasını ve bu hoşnutluk durumunu açıkça birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve, genel beğeniden çok verilen şeye bağlı yetinme ve yatışma koşulunu doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız sevmek veya genel kabul göstermek değil, bir bağış ya da pay karşısında hoşnut olup onunla yetinmektir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak dalın hoşnutluk ve hoşnut etme alanını verir; mal edinme dalını buna taşımaz.

concept_map.definition: Birini kendisine verilen şeyle hoşnut ederek onun bu payla yetinmesini ve gönlünün yatışmasını sağlamaktır. Aynı zamanda verilenle yetinme ve bundan hoşnut olma durumunu anlatır.

facets.statement: Bir kişi kendisine verilen şeyle hoşnut edilir ve gönlü yatıştırılır.
Alan kişi verilen payı yeterli bulur, onunla yetinir ve huzur duyar.
Sözcük, hoşnut etme eyleminin yanında hoşnutluk ve yetinme durumunu da adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar hoşnut etme ile verilen paya razı olup onunla yetinme ve gönlü yatışma durumunu aynı anlam alanında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.text: verilenle hoşnut olup yetinme ve bunu sağlama
concept_gloss.applicability: Hem verilen payla yetinip gönlü yatışan kişiyi hem de onu bu duruma getirme eylemini kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Hoşnutluğu, verilenle yetinmeyi ve birini bu duruma getirmeyi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birinin aldığı payla yetinmesi ve gönlünün yatışması sağlandığında kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Hoşnutluk durumunu ad olarak bildiren kullanımı dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli bir söz kalıbında birine yaptığına denk bir karşılık vermeyi ve aynı fiilin karşılık vermek anlamını açıkça bildirir. Geçici çerçeve bu sınırlı karşılıklandırma kullanımını doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam genel ödül, ücret veya hukukî geri verme değil, belirtilmiş söz ve fiil biçimlerinde yapılanı karşılıksız bırakmamaktır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız tanıklanan söz kalıbı ve fiil biçimindeki karşılık verme anlamını korur; bunu çıplak kök anlamına genellemez.

Bu anlam yalnız tanıklanan söz kalıbı ve karşılık verme fiil biçimi içinde geçerlidir.

word_morpheme_spans.note: Accepted bridge links preserve independent analysis identities. Several analysis entries may share canonical morphemes. Read their distinct semantic claims; shared morphology alone is not duplication. Legacy aligned_qac_word_ref values are source observations, not QAC joins. Excluded source entries remain available with their explicit qualification.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: Legacy analysis and QAC numbers are separate source namespaces. Use accepted word_morpheme_spans for actual many-to-many joins. The legacy numbering observation is preserved, not used for alignment.

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.

root_lexicon.note: Turkish is the only language with dictionary entries/glosses currently sourced.
